page.overview:
Who is Diana Cole?

Diana Cole was the wife of Craig Cole and had two children: Marcie and Daniel. Diana was a caring and worried mother as she would often call to check up on her daughter and her son-in-law Ryan Nichols. In 1999, The Coles had arranged for Daniel to be babysat by teenager Lisa Thomas. When they returned home, they discovered that Daniel and Lisa were missing and had no idea where they were for two days until the police found them trapped in the basement of the Bowles house. After this incident Diana blamed Lisa for what had happened to her and she never talked to Lisa again, although her son still liked Lisa and would have his mother send Lisa a couple of drawings he would do. Diana did as her son wished for but still refused Lisa to have any other contact with her family.

Around October 23, 2000, Haddonfield, Illinois murderer Michael Myers broke into the Cole home and slit the throats of Diana and her family. He arranged their bodies to sit in front of the TV in their living room and covered the front door knob with razor blades. The Cole family was found the next week by Lisa and Ryan.
